name: Ideal.exists_ltSeries_of_hasGoingDown
statement: LTSeries (PrimeSpectrum R)) (P : Ideal S) [P.IsPrime] [lo : P.LiesOver l.last.asIdeal] : ∃ (L : LTSeries (PrimeSpectrum S)), L.length = l.length ∧ L.last = ⟨P, inferInstance⟩ ∧ List.map (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R S)) L.toList = l.toList

name: of_comap_localRingHom_surjective
statement: ∀ (P : Ideal S) [P.IsPrime], Function.Surjective (PrimeSpectrum.comap <| Localization.localRingHom (P.under R) P (algebraMap R S) rfl)) : Algebra.HasGoingDown R S where exists_ideal_le_liesOver_of_lt {p} _ Q _ hlt
